prompt: ONE original square premium PAINTERLY CINEMATIC Mitoloka illustration of Nightmarchers, the deadly sacred GHOSTS of ancient Hawaiian warriors. Use strongly visible oil-painted brushwork and sculpted shadows, never photographic faces. ANATOMY: THREE distinct ADULT Hawaiian warrior spirits foremost, more shadowy warriors marching in ranks behind. Each normal human size, ONE head, TWO natural dark eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs. Grave angular ancient faces, ashen desaturated skin in red torchlight, no modern portrait resemblance, no wounds, skeletal features, glowing eyes, masks or tattoos [nightmarchers-c01,c05]. COSTUME: fully opaque plain MALO LOINCLOTHS wrap hips and groin, shoulder capes hang over back and shoulders; cloth is SMOOTH BEATEN KAPA BARK CLOTH, flat dense cream/tan sheets with soft crumples and clean edges, NOT woven fabric, NOT burlap, NOT sacks, no fringes, no ankle skirts, no togas, no robe. No helmets, feathers, jewelry, armor or fantasy costume [c05,c18]. WEAPONS: long ROUND DARK WOODEN POLES with their own ends simply WHITTLED TO THIN NEEDLE POINTS like giant sharpened pencils. Each pole maintains its NARROW CYLINDRICAL THICKNESS until a smooth LONG TAPER at the very end, no widening whatsoever. One uninterrupted stick of matte dark brown wood. NEVER leaf shape, flat blade, flared or broadened tip, triangular spearhead, diamond point, socket, collar, separate head, binding, engraving, metal or stone. Think sharpened wooden fishing pole, not a medieval spear [c05]. MOMENT: ADVANCE inexorably toward viewer above a black still-water tidal pool, spear leader in foreground holding his wooden spear diagonally across torso with BOTH HANDS. His head faces straight at lens, severe unblinking DIRECT EYE CONTACT, mouth closed. Other warriors advance behind as a solemn sacred rank [c03,c04,c07]. POWER: all visible bare feet HOVER A FULL FOREARM LENGTH ABOVE THE FLAT WATER, not walking on water, not touching it. Leave an obvious wide EMPTY DARK GAP between every foot and its reflection. Feet at about ONE THIRD UP FROM BOTTOM of frame. Bottom third shows utterly STILL mirror water and UNDISTURBED reflections beneath them, NO ripples, wakes, splashes, footprints or touching shadows. Light physical cold grey mist low over water, thin enough not to hide the floating gap [c06]. SCALE & CAMERA: extremely low camera at water surface looking upward, leader fills height and fixes viewer with stare, feet and large empty hover gaps remain in frame. Human size, no giants. LIGHT & WEATHER: REAL RED-BURNING TORCHES among rear ranks are the ONLY LIGHT SOURCE, hard deep red-orange light across grave painted faces and smooth kapa with near-black shadows. No moon, moonlight, blue lighting, glowing bodies, fog aura or luminous outlines [c11,c18]. SURFACE: smooth beaten bark cloth, matte continuous dark wood, bare feet and stark weathered ancestral faces, black volcanic rocks, glass-flat black tidal water. SETTING: night Hawaiian lava-rock shoreline, dark ocean and further ranks behind, procession rising from ocean toward sacred sites [c04]. MOOD: overwhelming sacred ancestral authority, the DEAD approach and see the viewer, solemn dangerous awe, never a beach reenactment, ordinary friendly soldiers or calm living modern men. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, letters, logo, border, watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or digits; no invented tattoos, skeletal features, glowing eyes, aura, runes, energy ribbons or borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; no victims, nudity or gore. Strong painterly house style and hovering feet must be unmistakable at 200px.

rejected_attempts.reason: Codex native self-reject: leader spear still has a leaf-shaped flared head with collar-like separation, so one-piece hardwood construction is insufficiently clear. Keep corrected painterly faces, kapa and levitation; regenerate plain tapering wooden poles.
